description: "The Little Nightcap Letters by Aunt Fanny" is a collection of charming children's letters and stories written in the late 19th century. The book is centered around a series of affectionate correspondence from Aunt Fanny to her dear little niece, Bella, as well as to other children, sharing delightful anecdotes, moral lessons, and whimsical tales.
